name: Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce – Product Designer & Personalizer
author: CoderPress

sections.description:
👑Get Pro | 💻Live Demo | 📃Documentation | 🎧Support

Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce lets you add product personalization to your WooCommerce store, so customers can customize supported products before placing an order.

Give shoppers a visual editor where they can arrange design elements and preview their designs as they customize a product. It is suitable for stores selling custom apparel, personalized gifts, accessories, promotional merchandise, and other products that customers want to make their own.

Start with the free product designer and its core customization tools. Upgrade to Pro when you need additional capabilities such as customer image uploads, advanced text editing, drawing tools, downloadable design files, and advanced order management.

Explore the live demo to see the product designer in action.

Features

  • Visual product designer: Give customers an interactive way to personalize supported products.
  • Drag-and-drop editing: Let customers arrange supported design elements on the product canvas.
  • Live product preview: Allow shoppers to review their designs while customizing a product.
  • Clipart library: Provide ready-to-use graphic elements for product designs.
  • Text customization: Let customers add text using the available editor features.
  • WooCommerce integration: Add product customization to your existing WooCommerce store.
  • Design and order management: Access design-related order information through the plugin’s administration tools.
  • Pro customization tools: Add capabilities such as customer image uploads, advanced text controls, drawing tools, and downloadable design files.

Feature availability depends on the installed plugin version and plan. See the Free and Pro sections below for details.

What Can You Create?

Use the product designer for customizable products such as:

  • T-shirts, hoodies, and other apparel
  • Mugs, cups, and drinkware
  • Phone cases and accessories
  • Jewelry and personalized gifts
  • Caps, hats, and merchandise
  • Print-on-demand products
  • Corporate gifts and promotional merchandise
  • Wedding, event, and celebration products

Choose a setup that fits your products, design area, and production workflow.

Free Version Features

Get started with product customization using the core features included in the free plugin.

  • Drag-and-drop product designer
  • Product canvas system
  • Image placement and resizing for supported design elements
  • Real-time product preview
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Product configuration tools
  • Product setup without coding

Customer image uploads and other advanced customization capabilities require Pro.

Pro Version Features

Upgrade to Pro when your store needs additional product design and order management functionality.

  • Unlimited customizable products
  • Customer image uploads
  • Advanced text editor with additional font, color, and sizing controls
  • Freehand drawing tools
  • Downloadable design files
  • Advanced order management
  • Priority support
  • 14-day money-back guarantee

Visit the Pro product page for current pricing, licensing details, and feature availability.

How to Get Started

  1. Install and activate Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce.
  2. Open the plugin’s product builder and configure a customizable product.
  3. Set up the product canvas and available design elements.
  4. Add the customizable product to your WooCommerce catalog.
  5. Visit the product page and test the customer-facing design experience.
  6. Review the resulting order and design information in your WordPress dashboard.

For detailed setup instructions, visit the official documentation.

Why Choose Custom Product Builder?

  • Start without building a custom solution: Configure product personalization within your WooCommerce store.
  • Offer interactive shopping: Let customers visualize their designs before ordering.
  • Grow at your own pace: Begin with the free features and upgrade when you need more tools.
  • Keep your workflow in WordPress: Manage your store and product customization in your WordPress environment.
  • Access design-related order information: Use the plugin’s administration interface to review design details.
  • Get ongoing improvements: Access product updates, documentation, and support from CoderPress.
  • Choose a suitable license: Explore available Pro plans, including lifetime licensing where offered.

Who Is It For?

Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce can help:

  • Print-on-demand businesses
  • Custom apparel stores
  • Personalized gift shops
  • Promotional product companies
  • Jewelry and engraving businesses
  • Wedding and event merchandise stores
  • WooCommerce merchants offering customizable products
sections.faq:
What is Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce?

Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce is a product designer plugin that adds visual product customization to your WooCommerce store. Customers can personalize supported products using the available design tools and preview their designs before ordering.

What is a WooCommerce product designer?

A WooCommerce product designer lets customers customize products before purchase. Depending on the plugin’s features and configuration, customers may be able to add text, arrange graphics, upload images, and preview their designs.

Can customers design their own products?

Yes. Customers can customize supported products using the visual editor and live preview. Available tools depend on the product configuration and plugin version.

Which products can I customize?

You can configure products such as apparel, mugs, phone cases, gifts, accessories, and promotional merchandise. Set up the design area and customization options to suit each product.

Can customers upload their own images?

Customer image uploads are available in the Pro version. The free version includes image placement and resizing for supported design elements, including elements provided by the plugin.

Does the plugin support text customization?

Yes. The product designer supports text customization. Additional text editing controls, including advanced font, color, and sizing options, are available in Pro.

Can customers preview their designs before purchasing?

Yes. The plugin provides a live product preview so customers can review their designs during customization.

Can I use this plugin for a print-on-demand store?

Yes. The plugin is suitable for WooCommerce stores selling customizable merchandise, apparel, personalized gifts, and other products that benefit from customer-driven design. Before production, verify that the design output meets your workflow’s requirements for dimensions, resolution, and file format.

Can I charge extra for product customization?

Pro supports additional pricing capabilities for supported customization options. Check the current documentation for available pricing controls and configuration requirements.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. A free version is available from WordPress.org. Pro adds advanced capabilities, including customer image uploads and additional design and order management features.

Do I need coding skills to set up a customizable product?

No.

Is the product designer mobile-friendly?

The product designer is intended for use across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Test your theme, product configuration, and customer-facing customization workflow on the devices you support.

Can I manage customer designs and orders?

The plugin provides design-related order management features. Pro also includes advanced order management capabilities. Consult the documentation to confirm which tools are available in your installed version.

Is this an alternative to Fancy Product Designer or Lumise?

Custom Product Builder for WooCommerce is another option for WooCommerce merchants who need product customization. Compare available features, pricing, design workflow, file output, and support to determine which solution best fits your store.

Where can I find documentation and support?

Use the official documentation for setup guides and feature instructions, or contact the CoderPress team through the support page.

Is there a refund policy for Pro?

Pro purchases include a 14-day money-back guarantee, subject to the applicable purchase terms. See the official product page for details.
